proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4345 article gives Malayalam pū, pūvu flower, blossom, comb of a cock, menses; pūkka to blossom, bud, expand, menstruate; pūkkal flowering; pūppu growing, a crop, menses; pūppikka to cause to blossom.. The Malayalam survey form pū “flower” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
